name: Tao Ren
headline: Building agents for complex work.
intro: I'm Tao Ren (Tempest), an AI engineer and independent researcher. I build agents for document-heavy workflows and software engineering, and study how language models edit and generate structured content.
summary: At Newfront, I work on Nova Agent for insurance operations. Previously at TikTok, I built an LLM coding agent for Objective-C-to-Swift migration with custom evaluation harnesses. My research includes FineEdit, TreeDiff, and Infant Agent.

current.summary: An internal AI coworker for insurance operators. I work on document-heavy workflows, generated contracts, company-style email drafts, tool use, and human-in-the-loop review.
current.detail: A task can involve more than 50 PDFs, policy and submission documents, generated contracts, and internal services. My work connects tools, document processing, structured outputs, and operator review with the constraints of an insurance workflow.

highlights.name: Nova Agent
highlights.label: Production agents · Insurance
highlights.summary: An insurance AI coworker for complex document workflows, artifact generation, and operator review.
highlights.contribution: I work on agent system design and production engineering around tools, skills, memory, document processing, permissions, and human review. Work on quoting and placement services informs how I integrate the agent with the surrounding workflow.
highlights.problem: Insurance operators work across large document sets and internal services to prepare contracts and communications.
highlights.approach: The workflow connects policy and submission documents to generated artifacts that operators can inspect. A single task can involve more than 50 PDFs.

highlights.name: TikTok coding agent
highlights.label: Developer tooling · Code migration
highlights.summary: Built an internal LLM agent for Objective-C to Swift migration, with generation loops and custom evaluation harnesses.
highlights.contribution: I built the internal agent from scratch, including code-generation loops and custom evaluation harnesses, and iterated on prompts and generated code.
highlights.problem: Migrating Objective-C code to Swift requires generated code that is useful within an existing engineering workflow.
highlights.approach: Evaluation was part of the development loop: generated code was checked and refined for practical migration work. My mobile product engineering experience helped ground the tooling in developer needs.

highlights.name: FineEdit
highlights.label: Findings of EMNLP 2025
highlights.summary: Research on precise, instruction-driven editing in structured domains including code, LaTeX, and database languages.
highlights.contribution: Co-authored FineEdit, connecting a specialized editing model with the InstrEditBench benchmark for targeted modifications.
highlights.problem: Instruction-driven edits must preserve surrounding content and respect the structure of code, LaTeX, and database languages.
highlights.approach: The research evaluates precise edits across structured domains and extends evaluation to multi-turn editing scenarios.

highlights.name: TreeDiff
highlights.label: SURGeLLM at ACL 2026
highlights.summary: AST-guided code generation with diffusion language models, treating code as a structured object.
highlights.contribution: Co-authored TreeDiff, a syntax-aware diffusion framework that uses abstract syntax tree structure in the corruption process.
highlights.problem: Random token masking in diffusion language models does not capture the syntactic boundaries and hierarchical dependencies of code.
highlights.approach: The method masks tokens belonging to selected AST nodes, aligning reconstruction with program structure. Published in the SURGeLLM workshop proceedings at ACL 2026.

highlights.name: Infant Agent
highlights.label: Agent research · arXiv preprint, 2024
highlights.summary: Tool-integrated agents with task-aware functions, memory retrieval, and cost-aware API usage for multi-step tasks.
highlights.problem: Multi-step engineering and reasoning tasks need coordination beyond a single model response.
highlights.contribution: Co-authored research on a tool-integrated, logic-driven agent architecture with task-aware functions and hierarchical management.
highlights.approach: The work studies memory retrieval, tool integration, and API costs, with evaluations on software engineering and mathematical reasoning tasks.

research.name: RED
research.summary: Real-time scheduling for robotic inference under changing environmental dynamics. Published at RTSS 2023.
